title: Conditional Sentences: Mixed Practice — Quiz 84
content:
## Conditional Sentences: Mixed Practice

Choose the verb forms that match each conditional sentence.

### Lesson focus

1. He won't succeed unless he ___ harder. (work)
2. If man had wings, he would ___ a bird. (be)
3. If time had 'back' gears, I would ___ back to my college days. (go)

### Understand the pattern

A mixed revision exercise can include different conditional patterns in separate questions. Unless means if not in the relevant condition. It usually takes an affirmative verb when that affirmative expresses the condition that must be met.

### Worked answers and explanation

1. works
2. be
3. go

'He won't succeed unless he works harder' means he will not succeed if he does not work harder. The second and third sentences use hypothetical past conditions with would plus a base verb in the result.

### Try another

Rewrite: If you do not practise, you will not improve.

### Suggested answer

Unless you practise, you will not improve. Do not write 'unless you do not practise', because that changes the intended condition.
